Over the years we have grown into a 4500 square foot shop with several highly skilled cabinetmakers and the resources to build any project our clients can imagine.
about:
Cox Woodworking operates from Westmoreland, New Hampshire. The company was founded in 1981 by master cabinetmaker Terry Cox, who remains actively involved in design, drafting, client consultation, and shop work. What began as a one-person cabinetmaking operation has grown into a 4,500-square-foot facility staffed by several skilled cabinetmakers.

The shop produces custom cabinets and architectural millwork, fabricating windows, doors, custom moldings, gates, pillars, curved work, and turnings. It also delivers whole-house residential packages that encompass luxury kitchens, baths, libraries, wine cellars, home offices, and entertainment centers. Projects move from in-house design and drafting through fabrication in the 4,500-square-foot shop.

The firm serves high-end residential clients and architectural projects across New York, New England, and beyond. Its work has been featured in publications including New York Times Magazine, Boston Home Magazine, Antiques Magazine, and House & Garden.

The company emphasizes a commitment to long-term customer satisfaction and a willingness to tackle challenging projects, with the founder’s hands-on involvement ensuring quality at every stage.
